data.title: Electricity supply contract confirmed – tariff „Ökostrom Fix 12“
data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG confirms a new electricity supply contract under the tariff "Ökostrom Fix 12", starting 1 January 2026 with a 12-month initial term. The working price is 31.48 ct/kWh, the base price €12.90/month, and the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) is €78.00.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that your new electricity supplier, Beispiel Energie AG, will start supplying your home from 1 January 2026 and will handle the switch from your previous supplier. Check that the tariff details (price, monthly advance payment, meter number) match what you agreed to. No immediate action is required. The contract runs for an initial 12 months and then continues indefinitely, cancellable at any time with one month's notice; the app will track your cancellation window separately. Keep this document for your records.
